work.title: Roundel Procession
work.description: Vertical mixed-media collage incorporating a hand-drawn warplane, scattered compact discs, multiple concentric-circle targets in red, blue, green, and yellow, and two footballs against a white ground. Four yellow vertical bands bisect the composition; a small framed image is affixed near center, and the word 'GUERNICA' appears in the lower third.
work.composition: vertical procession on all-over roundel ground
